quotes.text: "Third reminder should be in correct order"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dialog sorts event.getAlarms() by calculated alarm fire date in descending order, then passes that list to the reminders row. getAlarms returns an array copy, so this sort does not reorder the item's stored alarm array. The tested negative offsets show one hour before the event, then one day, then six days; this is not an earliest-first rule for all absolute or positive-offset alarms. Reset passes an empty list. The added test checks Fluent ID/count metadata, exact order and clearing, but does not test mixed alarm relations, missing-date handling or alarm delivery.
title: The Calendar dialog sorts a copied alarm list by descending fire date and clears it on reset
